# FC Clubs

> FC Clubs is an independent FC27 Pro Clubs stats tracker for iOS and Android. It saves available match history, groups matches into session recaps, compares squad performance and helps scout opponents. It is not affiliated with EA Sports.

## Publisher

- FC Clubs Stats is an app by Studio 149 (Ideas. Apps. Games.), operated by Berkay Ogulcan Tutal.
- [Studio 149](https://studio149.dev/): Official studio website and other projects.
- [Studio 149 legal information](https://studio149.dev/impressum.html): Publisher details.
- For FC Clubs app support, use support@fcclubs.app.

## Product facts

- Supported game platforms: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC for FC27 Pro Clubs.
- Mobile requirements: iOS/iPadOS 26.1 or later; Android 13 or later.
- Free to download with one club slot and standard tracking. No FC Clubs account is required.
- Extra club slots and Pro Stats are separate optional one-time purchases. Pro Stats for all three slots does not unlock extra slots.
- Pro Stats adds Second Assists, Interceptions, Through Passes, Dribbles Completed and Beats (take-ons) in match and session views when the provider supplies those metrics. They are not lifetime totals.
- Session grouping is automatic and time-based. Forecasts are estimates from available club statistics.
- Data coverage is limited by the official Clubs data provider. Open and refresh regularly to save available matches. Background updates are best effort.
- Previously saved FC26 history stays separate and readable. New FC26 live tracking is paused.
- Apple iCloud and Android Google Drive backup are platform-specific; cross-platform history transfer is not supported.
- Latest release: 27.0.6, announced November 8, 2026. Download FC Clubs through the App Store or Google Play; availability depends on your store and region.

## Latest update — 27.0.6

- Combine League, Playoffs and Friendly match types inside FC27 Session Detail. The match list and session statistics follow your selection; All restores the full session.
- Compare FC27 player rankings with two-decimal goals, assists and goals + assists per match. Ratings and total counts keep their existing formats.
- Match Detail explains when the provider did not supply Pro Stats for a match. Studio 149 links are in Settings and Credits.
- iOS also adds clearer recovery guidance and diagnostics when saved data cannot open.
- [27.0.6 release notes](https://fcclubs.app/whats-new.html#v2706): Current platform-specific release notes.

## Previous update — 27.0.5

- Explore Community Icons in Preferences → App Icon: the free Mature Play FC icon and paid designs starting with AC Gravitas. Submit Yours opens the artwork submission site for review; submitting does not guarantee publication. Purchased icons can be restored through the same app store.
- Android adds six free app icons and Automatic theme matching. Both platforms correct all-time match totals to count playoff matches once.
- Community icon designs are separate optional purchases; availability and pricing depend on the app store and region.
- [27.0.5 release notes](https://fcclubs.app/whats-new.html#v2705): Community app icons, six free Android designs and corrected all-time match totals.
- [Submit Yours](https://contribute.fcclubs.app/): Send artwork for community icon review.
